title: Automated Self-Healing Cloud Infrastructure on AWS EC2: software artefact
description: Closed-loop (MAPE-K) pipeline that detects six fault classes on AWS EC2 from Prometheus metrics and remediates them with Ansible or Terraform. Software artefact of the MSc thesis "Automated Self-Healing Cloud Infrastructure: An Empirical Study of Observability-Triggered Terraform and Ansible Remediation on AWS EC2". The experimental dataset is deposited separately.

creators.name: Duong, Tat Hung
